_comment: Task 2.4: the MOUNTING scene -- the haul beat's payoff and the door chain's new start. Its carrier is inn.json's `pisces_mounting` NPC, present only in the door_retrieved -> door_mounted window. SEPARATE GRAPH FILE, not extra nodes inside pisces_magic.json, for the same engine reason ceria_dig_camp.json split: game.gd keys dialogue_graphs by basename and dialogue.gd always enters at the graph's own `start`, so a node parked inside pisces_magic could only be reached through Pisces's STREET hub -- and interactions.gd routes `conversation` for kind:npc/encounter only, so the pantry PROP cannot open a graph at all. Placing the graph here also makes `inn` the quest-giver map for door_that_goes_elsewhere again (test_content's travel-beat place-naming validator reads conversation_maps). The door NEVER speaks; Pisces is the voice. Post-reveal surface, so the SPOILER RULE no longer applies -- but the naming rule does: it is the Magical Door, never a Vol-9 name.

door_mounting._comment: BOTH exits bank and start -- the quest auto-start IS this conversation (spec section 2.5), so there is no way to leave the scene without the chain running. `door_chain_started` rides along as a LEGACY ALIAS: the id is frozen (shipped_ids) and test_shipped_ids requires a live producer, but Task 2.2 retired its original producer, so the mounting carries it. It now means exactly what door_mounted means, and every shipped consumer reads correctly under that sense.
door_mounting.speaker: Pisces
door_mounting.text: Mounted, hinged, and -- observe -- already holding a hop to Liscor's gate district without so much as a rune of encouragement. It works. Now let us see how far it can go.

door_mounting_far.speaker: Pisces
door_mounting_far.text: Farther than Liscor. The wardwork wants distance the way a bowstring wants release -- but push it unattuned and things will leak through that we did not invite. Properly? We attune it. Krshia stocks catalysts; I stock expertise.
